title: Modifications of use regulations for a community facility
previewText: The regulations of Section 99-11 (Special Streetscape Regulations) may be modified for a comunity facility provided the City Planning Commission certifies that the treatment of the facade preserves and enhances street life on Madison Avenue compatible with the character of the surrounding area.
